result.title: RETR: A Structure-Preserving RGB-Event Transformer for Robust 3D Lane Detection
result.summary: Robust 3D lane detection requires accurate metric road geometry recovery from visual inputs, yet conventional RGB-based approaches suffer from fragile lane evidence under adverse illumination, motion blur, and long-range perspective compression. Event cameras offer complementary high-temporal-resolution, high dynamic-range structural cues that are robust to these challenges, but their sparse, motion-dependent responses cannot be directly fused into consistent 3D geometry. In this paper, we present the first attempt to introduce event cameras into 3D lane detection. To enable systematic research, we first build two multimodal benchmarks with metric 3D lane annotations: DSEC-3DLD (real-world sequences) and Ev-OpenLane (large-scale simulated sequences). We further propose RETR, a structure preserving transformer that converts complementary RGB and event observations into coherent 3D lane geometry. RETR first aligns modality consistent evidence through Reciprocal Context Flow Fusion, then preserves thin and uncertain lane structures with Uncertainty Aware Structural Consolidation, and finally decodes ordered lane hypotheses using a Geometry State Decoder with proposal conditioned initialization, reference conditioned query evolution, and diversified geometric inquiry. Extensive experiments show that RETR achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks, especially showing strong improvements in challenging lighting and complex road geometry scenarios. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/duskswell/RETR.

AI.brief_summary: 论文首次将事件相机引入3D车道检测，构建两个带度量3D车道标注的多模态基准，并提出结构保持的RGB-Event Transformer：先做跨模态证据对齐的互上下文流融合，再以不确定性感知的结构整合保留细薄与不确定车道结构，最后由几何状态解码器通过提议条件初始化、参考条件查询演化和多假设几何探究输出有序车道结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「几何状态解码器」的迭代查询演化与多假设输出，以及显式保护细薄、不确定结构的做法，可能为LVR中几何与任务必要视觉信息在内部状态中的保留、信息坍缩与证据筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但具体状态表示与监督方式需读原文确认。
